title: When the Border Burns
author: M. M. Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
